# Beju Creative

> Beju Creative is a video editing studio based in Lithuania that works with creators, coaches, podcasters and SaaS teams worldwide. The studio edits short-form videos for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok and LinkedIn, edits long videos and podcast episodes, produces launch films, and runs content systems for clients. Work starts with a free sample, and revisions are unlimited.

Key facts:
- Name: Beju Creative. Website: https://bejucreative.digital/
- What it does: short-form video editing, long-video and podcast episode editing, launch films for SaaS and app launches, the Content Engine (a content system the studio builds and runs for a client), and ad creatives for e-commerce brands.
- Who it is for: creators, coaches, podcasters, course creators, SaaS and app teams, e-commerce brands.
- How it starts: apply for a free sample at https://bejucreative.digital/apply/. The studio edits one Short from a video the applicant already has. No payment and no card. Applications get a reply within one hour.
- Pricing: quoted per channel. The price depends on how many videos are needed each month, how long they are and how much motion design goes into them.
- Revisions: unlimited on every edit.
- Delivery: within 24 hours once the studio has the footage and the brief, and usually faster. Launch films are planned per project.
- Past work: Beju Creative has worked with BASED and with Sam Zia's team.
- Footage: stays private. Upload folders are shared only with the client, and raw files are deleted once the edits are approved. Payments run through Stripe.
- Track record: 10M+ views on content the studio has edited. 35+ creators, coaches and podcasters it has cut video for. 97% of clients stay after their first batch.
- How it works: 1) Apply, which takes two minutes. 2) See it on your own video: the studio edits a free sample Short. 3) The studio takes it over: you send recordings, and finished edits come back in your style within 24 hours, usually faster.
- Contact: hello@bejucreative.digital. Calls: https://cal.com/beju-creative/15min-call

## Start
- [Apply for a free sample](https://bejucreative.digital/apply/): four short steps, no payment, no card.

## Services
- [Short-form video editing](https://bejucreative.digital/short-form-video-editing/): Shorts, Reels and TikToks cut from long videos in the client's own style.
- [Podcast clip editing](https://bejucreative.digital/podcast-video-editing/): the strongest moments of each episode cut into short clips, and full episodes edited.
- [Video editing for coaches](https://bejucreative.digital/video-editing-for-coaches/): short-form and long-form editing for coaches and trainers.
- [Video editing for course creators](https://bejucreative.digital/video-editing-for-course-creators/): clips from lessons and webinars, long-video edits and launch films for course launches.
- [SaaS launch films](https://bejucreative.digital/saas-launch-videos/): product films for SaaS and app launches.
- [The Content Engine](https://bejucreative.digital/content-engine/): a content system the studio builds and runs. One recording goes in, and finished Reels come out all week.

## Work and guides
- [Work](https://bejucreative.digital/work/): Shorts, Reels and launch films the studio has made.
- [How to turn a podcast into short clips](https://bejucreative.digital/guides/turn-podcast-into-short-clips/): a step-by-step guide to finding, framing and captioning clips from an episode.
- [How video editing is priced](https://bejucreative.digital/guides/video-editing-pricing/): what shapes a video editing quote and how to compare two quotes.
- [FAQ](https://bejucreative.digital/faq/): the free sample, what the studio edits, pricing, revisions, payment and footage privacy.
